entities.name: Item
entities.description: The full item (product) card as Shamel holds it: names, up to 6 units with conversion factors, 6 sale prices with 6 currency fields, 6 per-unit prices, barcode and other codes, group, status flags, purchase price and two GL accounts (pp. 9-10, 51 fields). It is returned as a list by /Item/GetItems and embedded as ItemDetails.itm by /Item/getItemDetails; every stock, catalog, serial and sales record joins to it by code.

fields.name: code
fields.note: Arabic comment on the same-named write-model field: 'رقم الصنف' (item number), p. 20. Filtered by GetItems header itemCode (p. 9). Referenced by ItemStore.item_code, ItemCatalog.item_code, ItemSerial.itemCode, VoucherItems.code.

fields.name: name
fields.note: Write-model comment 'اسم الصنف' (item name), p. 20. Arabic text is typical (Q48).

fields.name: nameEn
fields.note: From the field name. camelCase, unlike most Item fields (Q45). The write model has no English-name field.

fields.name: unit1
fields.note: Write-model comment 'وحدة الصنف الرئيسية' (item's main unit), p. 20. unit2..unit6 convert to it via unitN_relation. ItemStore.main_unit presumably equals it.

fields.name: unit2
fields.note: Pairs with unit2_relation and unit_price_2. Empty when unused (assumed). VoucherItems.unit is an int, presumably an index 1..6 into unit1..unit6 (ISCO-49).

fields.name: unit3
fields.note: Pairs with unit3_relation and unit_price_3.

fields.name: unit4
fields.note: Pairs with unit4_relation and unit_price_4.

fields.name: unit5
fields.note: Pairs with unit5_relation and unit_price_5.

fields.name: unit6
fields.note: Pairs with unit6_relation and unit_price_6.

fields.name: unit2_relation
fields.meaning: Conversion factor between unit2 and the main unit
fields.note: Direction undocumented (assumed: how many unit1 in one unit2, e.g. 12 pieces per box). There is no unit1_relation because unit1 is the base.

fields.name: unit3_relation
fields.meaning: Conversion factor between unit3 and the main unit
fields.note: Same reading and caveat as unit2_relation.

fields.name: unit4_relation
fields.meaning: Conversion factor between unit4 and the main unit
fields.note: Same reading and caveat as unit2_relation.

fields.name: unit5_relation
fields.meaning: Conversion factor between unit5 and the main unit
fields.note: Same reading and caveat as unit2_relation.

fields.name: unit6_relation
fields.meaning: Conversion factor between unit6 and the main unit
fields.note: Same reading and caveat as unit2_relation.

fields.name: sale_parice1
fields.note: [sic 'price'], name kept. Six prices match the 6 price classes ('Get the 6 price classes name', /Files/GetPriceClasses, p. 6); a customer's class is Customer.price_class. Mapping unconfirmed (ISCO-29a). Currency possibly curr1 (ISCO-29b).

fields.name: sale_parice2
fields.note: [sic]. See sale_parice1. Currency possibly curr2.

fields.name: sale_parice3
fields.note: [sic]. See sale_parice1. Currency possibly curr3.

fields.name: sale_parice4
fields.note: [sic]. See sale_parice1. Currency possibly curr4.

fields.name: sale_parice5
fields.note: [sic]. See sale_parice1. Currency possibly curr5.

fields.name: sale_parice6
fields.note: [sic]. See sale_parice1. Currency possibly curr6.

fields.name: barcode
fields.note: Write-model comment 'الباركود' (barcode), p. 20. /Report/GetLastPriceReport accepts a barcode header (p. 12). Only one barcode per item is exposed.

fields.name: factory_code
fields.note: Write-model comment 'رقم المصنع' (factory number), p. 20.

fields.name: orginal_code
fields.note: [sic 'original'], name kept. The write model spells it original_code, commented 'الرقم الاصلي' (original number), p. 20 (Q29).

fields.name: stopped
fields.note: An int here but bool on Customer (Q44). Values undocumented (ISCO-49). Whether GetItems includes stopped items is not stated.

fields.name: paused
fields.note: How it differs from stopped is undocumented (ISCO-49).

fields.name: type
fields.note: Write-model comment 'نوع الصنف' (item type), p. 20. Values undocumented and no lookup endpoint (Q42, ISCO-48b, ISCO-49).

fields.name: has_serial
fields.meaning: Item tracked by serial number, 0/1 assumed
fields.note: Such items presumably appear in /Item/GetItemsSerials (ItemSerial). Values unconfirmed (ISCO-49).

fields.name: has_measure
fields.note: VoucherItems.measure is commented 'not used' (غير مستخدم), p. 14, so sizes cannot be sent on vouchers.

fields.name: has_color
fields.note: VoucherItems.color is commented 'not used' (غير مستخدم), p. 14.

fields.name: has_expiry
fields.note: No endpoint returns expiry or batch data.

fields.name: eval_unit
fields.meaning: Unknown; name suggests the unit used for stock valuation
fields.note: Possibly an index 1..6 into unit1..unit6 (guess). Values undocumented (ISCO-49).

fields.name: purchase_price
fields.note: Last purchase price vs average cost is unknown (ISCO-29d). Sensitive: margin data, hide from sales-facing tools.

fields.name: item_group_code
fields.note: -> ItemGroup.code. The ItemGroup comment calls it 'itemGroupCode' (p. 11; Q28, ISCO-35c). The write model calls it group.

fields.name: item_group_name
fields.note: Denormalised copy of ItemGroup.name (assumed).

fields.name: item_group_father_code
fields.note: -> ItemGroup.code of the parent; corresponds to ItemGroup.parentCode (unconfirmed, ISCO-35c). Only one parent level is carried on the item.

fields.name: item_group_father_name
fields.note: Denormalised copy of the parent ItemGroup.name (assumed).

fields.name: unit_price_1
fields.note: Undocumented. How it differs from sale_parice1 is unknown (ISCO-29b). The write-model price1 'سعر الوحدة الرئيسية' (main-unit price) may map here or to sale_parice1.

fields.name: unit_price_2
fields.note: Pairs with unit2 (per unit, not per class, assumed). See unit_price_1.

fields.name: unit_price_3
fields.note: Pairs with unit3. See unit_price_1.

fields.name: unit_price_4
fields.note: Pairs with unit4. See unit_price_1.

fields.name: unit_price_5
fields.note: Pairs with unit5. See unit_price_1.

fields.name: unit_price_6
fields.note: Pairs with unit6. See unit_price_1.

fields.name: credit_account
fields.meaning: GL account code credited for this item
fields.note: Which postings use it (sales, returns) is undocumented. No account lookup endpoint (Q42). Sensitive (chart of accounts).

fields.name: debit_account
fields.meaning: GL account code debited for this item
fields.note: Which postings use it is undocumented. No account lookup endpoint (Q42). Sensitive (chart of accounts).

fields.name: curr1
fields.note: Whether it belongs to sale_parice1 (price class 1) or unit_price_1 (unit 1) is unknown (ISCO-29b). Presumably Currency.code, e.g. 'NIS' (ISCO-28b).

fields.name: curr2
fields.note: See curr1: class 2 or unit 2 is unknown.

fields.name: curr3
fields.note: See curr1: class 3 or unit 3 is unknown.

fields.name: curr4
fields.note: See curr1: class 4 or unit 4 is unknown.

fields.name: curr5
fields.note: See curr1: class 5 or unit 5 is unknown.

fields.name: curr6
fields.note: See curr1: class 6 or unit 6 is unknown.

fields.name: orgnization_code
fields.note: [sic 'organization'], name kept. Also on Store; branch or company is unknown (ISCO-27c). No lookup endpoint (Q42).

entities.business_value: Build a product list or customer-class price list, check units, status and barcodes, and pull only changed items with the lastupdatedate header (GetItems also filters by serial, itemCode, store and model headers, p. 9).

entities.name: ItemStore
entities.plain_name: Stock quantity of an item in one store
entities.description: One row per item per store (warehouse or van) with the quantity, shelf and unit (p. 11). Returned in bulk by /Item/GetItemsStores ('Get all items quantities', p. 10; filters: lastupdatedate and itemcode headers, no store filter) and per item as ItemDetails.itmStores.

fields.name: item_code
fields.note: -> Item.code. Filtered by GetItemsStores header itemcode, all lower-case (p. 10; ISCO-13).

fields.name: store
fields.note: -> Store.id from /Files/GetStores (class printed as 'City', p. 6). GetItemsStores cannot filter by store (ISCO-36d).

fields.name: qnty
fields.meaning: Quantity of the item in this store
fields.note: Endpoint text 'Get all items quantities' (p. 10). Presumably in main_unit (ISCO-36a); zero or negative rows and reservations by open orders are undocumented (ISCO-36b,c).

fields.name: shelf
fields.meaning: Shelf / bin location in the store
fields.note: From the field name.

fields.name: main_unit
fields.meaning: Unit the quantity is counted in (main unit)
fields.note: Presumably equals Item.unit1 (ISCO-36a).

entities.business_value: See stock per warehouse or van, spot shortages or overstock, and tell staff which shelf an item is on.

entities.name: ItemDetails
entities.plain_name: One item with its stock per store
entities.description: A wrapper holding one item's full card plus its quantity in every store, looked up with the itemCode header (p. 11); it serves the p. 2 capability 'pull quantities of a specific item' (سحب كمات [sic] صنف معين). The manual says 'It return list of this structure' but the shape is a single object, so callers must accept either (Q32).

fields.name: itm
fields.note: Printed 'Itemitm;' with the space missing. Same 51-field shape as GetItems rows.

fields.name: itmStores
fields.meaning: The item's quantity in each store
fields.note: Same rows GetItemsStores returns for this item (assumed).

entities.business_value: Answer 'what is this item, what does it cost, and how much do we have where?' in a single call.

entities.name: ItemGroup
entities.description: A node in the item category tree with its parent code and level (p. 11). Items point to it through item_group_code and item_group_father_code. /Item/GetItemsGroups has no inputs and is not in the p. 2 capability list.

fields.name: code
fields.meaning: Group code; items refer to it
fields.note: Comment: 'Item has itemGroupCode field that refer to this field' (p. 11). The real Item field is item_group_code (Q28, ISCO-35c); the write-model group presumably takes this code.

fields.name: name
fields.note: From the field name; mirrored in Item.item_group_name.

fields.name: parentCode
fields.note: -> ItemGroup.code. The Item model calls it item_group_father_code (ISCO-35c). Value for top-level groups (empty or null) is undocumented.

fields.name: level
fields.meaning: Depth of the group in the tree
fields.note: Whether the top level is 0 or 1 is undocumented.

entities.business_value: Organise products into categories for menus, filters and sales-by-category reports.

entities.name: ItemCatalog
entities.description: Pairs an item code with the location of its picture ('Get all items image', p. 11). Only a path string comes back; its format, and how to fetch the image itself, are undocumented (ISCO-34). /Item/GetItemsCatalog has no item filter.

fields.name: item_code
fields.note: -> Item.code. No item filter: all items come back in one call.

fields.name: image_path
fields.note: From 'Get all items image' (p. 11). URL, local path or network (UNC) path is unknown, and no image-bytes endpoint is documented (Q26, ISCO-34). May expose internal server paths.

entities.business_value: Show product photos in a catalogue or ordering app, once ISCO confirms what image_path holds.

entities.name: ItemSerial
entities.description: One serial-numbered unit of an item with its status, store and warranty (guarantee) start and end dates (p. 12). Returned by /Item/GetItemsSerials ('Get all items with serials only', p. 11), filterable by customer code and serial headers; not in the p. 2 capability list.

fields.name: name
fields.note: Could also be a label for the serial unit; undocumented.

fields.name: itemCode
fields.note: -> Item.code. camelCase, unlike item_code elsewhere (Q45).

fields.name: serial
fields.note: Filtered by header serial ('serials with this serial code only', p. 11). GetItems also has a serial header (ISCO-35a).

fields.name: status
fields.meaning: Status of the serial; values not documented
fields.note: E.g. in stock vs sold is a guess (ISCO-49). The customer header ('serials with this customer code only', p. 11) filters by customer, yet no customer field is returned.

fields.name: store
fields.note: -> Store.id from /Files/GetStores.

fields.name: start_grantee_date
fields.note: [sic 'guarantee'], name kept. Date as a string, presumably yyyy-MM-dd (p. 4).

fields.name: end_grantee_date
fields.note: [sic 'guarantee'], name kept. Presumably yyyy-MM-dd (p. 4).

entities.business_value: Track individual devices by serial number, check warranty dates for after-sales service, and list serials linked to a customer.

entities.name: LastPriceRepColumn
entities.description: One row of the 'last prices' report (تقرير اخر الأسعار, p. 3) for one item: date, document code, price, currency, quantity, bonus, unit and customer (p. 12). Inputs are headers ItemCode ('mandatory') and barcode; the manual's 'ItemCode is optional' next to barcode contradicts itself (Q21, ISCO-37a).

fields.name: date
fields.note: String; presumably yyyy-MM-dd (p. 4).

fields.name: code
fields.note: Voucher code is unconfirmed (ISCO-37d). The row has no item-code field because the report is for the item in the ItemCode header.

fields.name: price
fields.note: Whether net of discount or VAT is undocumented. Which voucher types count (sales only?) is unknown (ISCO-37d).

fields.name: currency
fields.note: Presumably Currency.code (ISCO-28b).

fields.name: quantity
fields.note: Presumably in the unit given by unit.

fields.name: bonus
fields.note: By analogy with VoucherItems.bonus 'كمية البونص' (bonus quantity), p. 14.

fields.name: unit
fields.meaning: Unit name the price applies to
fields.note: A string here, while VoucherItems.unit is an int (p. 14).

fields.name: customer
fields.meaning: Customer of the transaction (code or name)
fields.note: Printed 'stringcustomer' with the space missing. Code vs name unknown; no customer filter, so whose prices are returned is unclear (Q21, ISCO-37b,c).

entities.business_value: Before quoting, see what price an item recently went for, in which unit and currency, and to whom.

entities.name: Item (write)
entities.description: The JSON object sent in form field obj to /Item/Post to 'Insert new Item' (pp. 19-20); the manual prints its class name as plain 'Item'. Every field has an Arabic comment; it is a smaller, differently named set than the read model (one unit, one price, one currency), and the caller supplies the item code.

fields.name: code
fields.note: Comment 'رقم الصنف' (item number). Whether an existing code is rejected is unknown (ISCO-43d).

fields.name: unit1
fields.note: Comment 'وحدة الصنف الرئيسية' (item's main unit). No unit2..unit6 can be set.

fields.name: name
fields.note: Comment 'اسم الصنف' (item name). No English-name field (read nameEn).

fields.name: type
fields.note: Comment 'نوع الصنف' (item type). Allowed values undocumented (ISCO-48b, ISCO-49).

fields.name: price1
fields.note: Comment 'سعر الوحدة الرئيسية' (main-unit price). Whether it becomes sale_parice1 or unit_price_1 is unclear (Q29, ISCO-29b). Only one price can be set.

fields.name: currency
fields.note: Comment 'العملة' (currency). Expected values unconfirmed (ISCO-48b); presumably Currency.code. Read model has curr1..curr6.

fields.name: group
fields.note: Comment 'تابع لصنف' (literally 'belongs to item [category]'). Presumably ItemGroup.code, read back as item_group_code (ISCO-48b).

fields.name: barcode
fields.note: Comment 'الباركود' (barcode).

fields.name: original_code
fields.note: Comment 'الرقم الاصلي' (original number). The read model spells it orginal_code (Q29).

fields.name: factory_code
fields.note: Comment 'رقم المصنع' (factory number).

fields.name: trademark
fields.note: Comment 'العلامة التجارية' (trademark). Numeric id with no lookup endpoint; not returned by any read (Q42, ISCO-48c).

fields.name: producing_company
fields.note: Comment 'الشركة المنتجة' (producing company). No lookup endpoint; write-only (Q42, ISCO-48c).

fields.name: style
fields.note: Comment 'الطراز' (style). No lookup endpoint; write-only (Q42, ISCO-48c).

fields.name: model
fields.note: Comment 'الموديل' (model). GetItems has a model filter header, but no read returns the field (Q29, ISCO-35a).

fields.name: note
fields.note: Comment 'ملاحظة النصف' [sic: ملاحظة الصنف, item note] (Q30). Not returned by any read.

entities.business_value: Create new products in Shamel from another system (online shop, supplier price list) without retyping; insert only, with no update or delete endpoint (Q43, ISCO-23).

entities.name: PostResponse
entities.description: The JSON result of /Item/Post (p. 20) and /Customer/Post (p. 9): a success flag, an error message and a value. For customers the manual says value holds the new customer code; for items it does not say.

fields.name: Success
fields.note: PascalCase, unlike AuthResult.success (Q44). When a failure is HTTP 200 with Success=false vs HTTP 500 is undocumented (p. 4; ISCO-19).

fields.name: ErrorMessage
fields.meaning: Error text when the insert failed
fields.note: A single string here; the voucher Result uses string[] (p. 15). Message list undocumented (ISCO-19c).

fields.name: value
fields.meaning: Code of the inserted record (stated for customers only)
fields.note: Customer/Post: 'If the process succeeded, the value will contain the inserted code of the customer' (p. 9). Item/Post: not stated; presumably the item code (ISCO-48b).

entities.business_value: Confirm whether an insert worked and keep the code Shamel returned as the reference.
